The '''2005–06 Bundesliga''' was the 43rd season of the [[Bundesliga]], Germany's premier football league. It began on 5 August 2005 and concluded on 13 May 2006.<ref>{{cite web |url=https://www.worldfootball.net/competition/co12/se4034/all-matches/ |title=Bundesliga 2005/2006 » Schedule |website=WorldFootball.net |access-date=13 June 2020}}</ref>

==Teams==
Eighteen teams competed in the league&nbsp;– the top fifteen teams from the previous season and the three teams promoted from the [[2004–05 2. Bundesliga|2. Bundesliga]]. The promoted teams were [[1. FC Köln]], [[MSV Duisburg]] and [[Eintracht Frankfurt]]. 1. FC Köln and Eintracht Frankfurt returned to the top flight after an absence of one year while MSV Duisburg returned in the top flight after an absence of six years. They replaced [[VfL Bochum]], [[FC Hansa Rostock|Hansa Rostock]] and [[SC Freiburg]], ending their top flight spells of three, ten and two years respectively.
